questions.question: In an examination, 92% of the students passed and 480 students failed. If so, how many students appeared in the examination?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total percentage of students = 100%

Failure percentage = 100% − 92% = 8%

Given: 8% = 480 students

100% = (480 ÷ 8) × 100 = 60 × 100 = 6000

**∴ The correct answer is 6000 students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Pass percentage = 92%

Number of failed students = 480

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ac86d9fa992db6ce7394ea4ffa06449a5dd9c4f4f7b454832f9bcd4dd39b852.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Total Students = (Number of Failed Students ÷ Fail Percentage) × 100

**Calculations:**

Let the total number of students be x.

⇒ Fail Percentage = 100% − 92%

⇒ Fail Percentage = 8%

⇒ 8% of x = 480

⇒ (8 ÷ 100) × x = 480

⇒ x = (480 × 100) ÷ 8

⇒ x = 60 × 100

⇒ x = 6000

**∴ The correct answer is 6000 students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

8% is equivalent to 8/100 or 2/25. This means if 2 units represent the failures (480), then 1 unit = 240, and the total students (25 units) = 25 × 240 = 6000.

Concept of Base Change

When solving percentage problems, always identify the base (100%). In exams, the total number of students or the maximum marks usually represents the 100% base.

Total Students Rule

Total Students = Number of Passed Students + Number of Failed Students. Since 92% passed, the number of passed students = 6000 − 480 = 5520.</p

questions.question: An article is listed at Rs. 7,600 and the discount offered for the unit is 10%. What additional discount must be given to bring the net selling price to Rs. 5,814?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Marked Price = ₹7,600

Price after 1st discount (10%) = 7,600 − 760 = ₹6,840

Remaining amount to be discounted = 6,840 − 5,814 = ₹1,026

Additional discount % = (1,026 ÷ 6,840) × 100 = 15%

**∴ The correct answer is 15%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Listed Price (MP) = ₹7,600

First Discount (D₁) = 10%

Net Selling Price (SP) = ₹5,814

**Formula Used:**

Final SP = MP × (100 − D₁)/100 × (100 − D₂)/100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14d0803653806a9c8698bc1ae88db43c885f83719d5fb125eb8e0e5cef4827e5.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 7,600 × (90/100) = ₹6,840

⇒ Let the second discount be x%.

⇒ 5,814 = 6,840 × (100 − x)/100

⇒ 5,814 ÷ 6,840 = (100 − x)/100

⇒ 0.85 = (100 − x)/100

⇒ 85 = 100 − x

⇒ x = 100 − 85 = 15%

**∴ The correct answer is 15%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

When two discounts a% and b% are given, the single equivalent discount is (a + b − (a × b)/100)%.

Marked Price and Selling Price Relation

Selling Price = Marked Price − Discount. Also, SP = CP × (100 + Profit%)/100.

Discount Percentage

Discount% is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP): Discount% = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100.

questions.question: A and B can do a work together in 18 days. A is three times as efficient as B. In how many days can B alone complete the work?

Efficiency Ratio (A : B) = 3 : 1

Combined Efficiency (A + B) = 3 + 1 = 4 units/day

Total Work = Combined Efficiency × Combined Time = 4 × 18 = 72 units

Days taken by B alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of B = 72 ÷ 1 = 72 days

**∴ The correct answer is 72 days.**

questions.question: The number of lead balls, each 3 cm in diameter, that can be made from a solid lead sphere of diameter 42 cm is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Number of identical smaller spheres obtained by melting a larger sphere is the cube of the ratio of their dimensions.

Ratio of Diameters = Large Diameter ÷ Small Diameter = 42 ÷ 3 = 14.

Number of balls = (Ratio)³ = 14³.

Number of balls = 14 × 14 × 14 = 2744.

**∴ The correct answer is 2744 balls.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter of the solid lead sphere (D) = 42 cm

Diameter of each small lead ball (d) = 3 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a sphere = (4/3) × π × r³

Number of balls = Volume of large sphere ÷ Volume of one small ball

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f71dd93ca3899411b26e6a93a986c9b9dd94132d7bd533bac8f2f58750ca3c3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Radius of large sphere (R) = 42 ÷ 2 = 21 cm

⇒ Radius of small ball (r) = 3 ÷ 2 = 1.5 cm

⇒ Number of balls (N) = [(4/3) × π × R³] ÷ [(4/3) × π × r³]

⇒ N = R³ ÷ r³ = (R ÷ r)³

⇒ N = (21 ÷ 1.5)³

⇒ N = (14)³

⇒ N = 14 × 14 × 14 = 2744

**∴ The correct answer is 2744 balls.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Recasting Rule

When one solid object is melted and recast into multiple smaller objects of the same or different shapes, the total volume remains constant (VolumeIₙᵢₜᵢₐₗ = VolumeFᵢₙₐₗ).

Volume of Hemisphere

The volume of a hemisphere is exactly half of the volume of a sphere: Volume = (2/3) × π × r³.

Total Surface Area of Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere with radius r is given by the formula: Area = 4 × π × r².</p

questions.question: The sum of length, breadth and height of a cuboid is 20 cm. If the length of the diagonal is 12 cm, then find the total surface area of cuboid.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula for Total Surface Area (TSA) when Sum (S) and Diagonal (D) are given:

TSA = (Sum of dimensions)² − (Length of diagonal)²

⇒ TSA = (20)² − (12)²

⇒ TSA = 400 − 144 = 256 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 256 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03f4ee5cc7f7bdb82dc219ead601b4b4ebf2ce6acf536ddf7c1ba649db664387.png] 

**Given:**

Sum of length, breadth, and height (l + b + h) = 20 cm

Length of the diagonal (d) = 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

1. Diagonal (d) = √(l² + b² + h²)

2. Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2(lb + bh + hl)

3. Algebraic Identity: (l + b + h)² = l² + b² + h² + 2(lb + bh + hl)

**Calculations:**

⇒ From the diagonal formula: d² = l² + b² + h²

⇒ 12² = l² + b² + h² ⇒ 144 = l² + b² + h²

⇒ Using the identity: (20)² = (l² + b² + h²) + TSA

⇒ 400 = 144 + TSA

⇒ TSA = 400 − 144

⇒ TSA = 256 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 256 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cuboid

The volume of a cuboid is the product of its dimensions: V = l × b × h.

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The area of the four side walls of the cuboid is given by: LSA = 2h(l + b).

Properties of a Cube

A cube is a special cuboid where l = b = h = a. Here, TSA = 6a² and Diagonal = a√3.

Diagonal and Sum relation

For any rectangular parallelepiped, the sum of dimensions, the diagonal, and the surface area are related by (l+b+h)² = d² + TSA.</p

questions.question: Anil bought two articles A and B at a total cost of Rs. 10,000. He sold the article A at 15% profit and the article B at 10% loss. In the whole deal, he made no profit or no loss. Find the selling price of the article A.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of CP of A to CP of B by Alligation = |0 − (−10)| : |15 − 0| = 10 : 15 = 2 : 3

Total units = 2 + 3 = 5 units → ₹10,000

CP of article A = 2 units = (10,000 ÷ 5) × 2 = ₹4,000

SP of article A = 115% of CP = 1.15 × 4,000 = ₹4,600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Cost Price (CP) of A and B = ₹10,000

Profit on article A = 15%

Loss on article B = 10%

Net Profit/Loss = 0%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (100 + Profit%)/100

Using Alligation to find the ratio of CP of two articles:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97ea8eaa6693ebe1ed56166fd291b7987f7a25b96b3ceeb0c245b95e45b4b507.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let CP of A be 2x and CP of B be 3x.

⇒ 2x + 3x = 10,000

⇒ 5x = 10,000

⇒ x = 2,000

⇒ Cost Price of A (CPA) = 2 × 2,000 = ₹4,000

⇒ Selling Price of A (SPA) = CPA + 15% of CPA

⇒ SPA = 4,000 + (15/100) × 4,000

⇒ SPA = 4,000 + 600 = ₹4,600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alligation Rule in Profit and Loss

When two articles are sold, the ratio of their Cost Prices is given by the ratio of the differences between the individual profit/loss percentages and the overall profit/loss percentage.

No Profit No Loss Condition

In a "no profit no loss" scenario, the absolute value of the profit earned on one article must be exactly equal to the absolute value of the loss incurred on the other article: Profit on A = Loss on B.

Selling Price Formula

SP = CP × (100 ± P/L)% where '+' is used for profit and '−' is used for loss.

questions.question: The ratio of boys and girls in a school is 27 : 23. If the difference between the number of boys and girls is 200, then find the number of boys.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Boys : Girls = 27 : 23

Difference in ratio units = 27 − 23 = 4 units

Given: 4 units = 200 ⇒ 1 unit = 50

Number of boys = 27 units = 27 × 50 = 1350

**∴ The correct answer is 1350.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of boys to girls = 27 : 23

Difference between boys and girls = 200

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/622e1cca45e3302c95f4ef612551dc43607e07234ab36eb253cbf65c18dfae34.png] 

Let the number of boys be 27x and the number of girls be 23x.

According to the question:

⇒ 27x − 23x = 200

⇒ 4x = 200

⇒ x = 200 ÷ 4

⇒ x = 50

Now, find the number of boys:

⇒ Number of boys = 27x

⇒ Number of boys = 27 × 50

⇒ Number of boys = 1350

**∴ The correct answer is 1350.**

**__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion Basics

A ratio a:b can be represented as a fraction a/b. If a:b = c:d, then ad = bc (Product of extremes = Product of means).

Total Value from Ratio

To find the total quantity when parts are given in ratio a:b and difference is D, Total = [(a + b) × D] ÷ |a − b|.

Duplicate and Triplicate Ratios

Duplicate ratio of a:b is a²:b² and triplicate ratio is a³:b³.</p

questions.question: The interior angle of a regular polygon exceeds its exterior angle by 90°.The number of sides of the polygon is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interior Angle (I) + Exterior Angle (E) = 180°

Given: I − E = 90°

Adding the two: 2I = 270° ⇒ I = 135°

Subtracting the two: 2E = 90° ⇒ E = 45°

Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ Exterior Angle = 360° ÷ 45° = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Interior angle (I) − Exterior angle (E) = 90°

**Formula Used:**

1. Interior angle + Exterior angle at any vertex = 180°

2. Number of sides of a regular polygon (n) = 360° ÷ Exterior angle

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/719bfd8b19d5272041bf8c6829f348c8ff8fc03f70360e3751aa8d00d966a55e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the interior angle be I and the exterior angle be E.

⇒ I − E = 90° --- (Equation 1)

⇒ I + E = 180° --- (Equation 2)

⇒ Subtracting (1) from (2):

⇒ (I + E) − (I − E) = 180° − 90°

⇒ 2E = 90°

⇒ E = 45°

⇒ Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ E

⇒ n = 360° ÷ 45°

⇒ n = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of all interior angles of a polygon with n sides is given by (n − 2) × 180°.

Each Interior Angle of a Regular Polygon

For a regular polygon, each interior angle = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n.

Sum of Exterior Angles

The sum of all exterior angles of any convex polygon is always equal to 360°.

Relation between Side and Exterior Angle

For a regular polygon, each exterior angle = 360° ÷ n, where n is the number of sides.</p

questions.question: The radii of two cylinders are in the ratio 3 : 4 and their heights are in the ratio 8 : 5. The ratio of their volumes is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of a cylinder (V) ∝ r²h

Ratio of volumes V₁ : V₂ = (r₁/r₂)² × (h₁/h₂)

V₁ : V₂ = (3/4)² × (8/5) = (9/16) × (8/5)

V₁ : V₂ = (9 × 1) : (2 × 5) = 9 : 10

**∴ The correct answer is 9 : 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of radii (r₁ : r₂) = 3 : 4

Ratio of heights (h₁ : h₂) = 8 : 5

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder (V) = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3fbf84212780c6beab2aaf3f0a8fd7cafc9370cbd3a81a7c9a8fcc67c902914.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the radii be 3x and 4x, and the heights be 8y and 5y.

⇒ Volume of first cylinder (V₁) = π × (3x)² × 8y

⇒ V₁ = π × 9x² × 8y = 72πx²y

⇒ Volume of second cylinder (V₂) = π × (4x)² × 5y

⇒ V₂ = π × 16x² × 5y = 80πx²y

⇒ Ratio V₁ : V₂ = 72πx²y : 80πx²y

⇒ Ratio V₁ : V₂ = 72 : 80

⇒ Ratio V₁ : V₂ = 9 : 10

**∴ The correct answer is 9 : 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a Cylinder

The lateral surface area of a cylinder is given by the formula CSA = 2πrh, where r is the radius and h is the height.

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a Cylinder

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the two circular bases: TSA = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(h + r).

Ratio of Volumes of Cones

Similar to cylinders, the ratio of the volumes of two cones with the same radii and height ratios is also (r₁/r₂)² × (h₁/h₂), as V = 1/3 πr²h.</p

questions.question: Find the least number which when divided by 12, 18, 24 and 30 leaves 4 as remainder in each case, but when divided by 7 leaves no remainder.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the number that is exactly divisible by 7 from the given options.

Option 1: 366 ÷ 7 → Remainder = 2

Option 2: 634 ÷ 7 → Remainder = 4

Option 3: 384 ÷ 7 → Remainder = 6

Option 4: 364 ÷ 7 = 52 → Remainder = 0

Since 364 is the only option divisible by 7, it is the required number.

**∴ The correct answer is 364.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Divisors = 12, 18, 24, 30; Common Remainder = 4; Special Divisor = 7.

**Formula Used:** Number = LCM(Divisors) × k + Remainder

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9a3782800d1155efb8355b41846b9e16c9faf333703c2234e427d3eff9da95f.png] 

⇒ Prime factors of 12 = 2² × 3

⇒ Prime factors of 18 = 2 × 3²

⇒ Prime factors of 24 = 2³ × 3

⇒ Prime factors of 30 = 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ LCM (12, 18, 24, 30) = 2³ × 3² × 5 = 8 × 9 × 5 = 360

⇒ General form of the number = 360k + 4

⇒ To satisfy divisibility by 7: (360k + 4) ÷ 7 must have remainder 0

⇒ (360k + 4) = (7 × 51k) + (3k + 4)

⇒ For the number to be divisible by 7, (3k + 4) must be divisible by 7.

⇒ If k = 1: 3(1) + 4 = 7 (Divisible by 7)

⇒ Least number = 360(1) + 4 = 364

**∴ The correct answer is 364.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM and Remainder Concept

When a number is divided by x, y, z and leaves remainder r in each case, the general form is LCM(x, y, z) × k + r.

Divisibility Rule of 7

Double the last digit and subtract it from the remaining number. If the result is divisible by 7, the original number is also divisible by 7.

Modular Arithmetic Shortcut

For (Ak + B) mod n = 0, reduce A and B by dividing with n to find the smallest value of k quickly.</p

questions.question: At what rate of interest will a sum of Rs. 4,500 amount to Rs. 6,525 at simple interest for 5 years?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Interest = 6525 − 4500 = ₹2025

Total Interest Percentage = (Interest ÷ Principal) × 100

⇒ Total Interest % = (2025 ÷ 4500) × 100 = 45%

Rate per annum = Total Interest % ÷ Time

⇒ Rate = 45% ÷ 5 = 9%

**∴ The correct answer is 9%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4500

Amount (A) = ₹6525

Time (T) = 5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08c427b8c4a6a80f32e5b5b2eb92d31b4746594a4df6a38578a7c2bf00aa18eb.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = Amount − Principal

⇒ SI = 6525 − 4500 = ₹2025

⇒ 2025 = (4500 × R × 5) ÷ 100

⇒ 2025 = 45 × R × 5

⇒ 2025 = 225 × R

⇒ R = 2025 ÷ 225

⇒ R = 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

Simple Interest remains constant every year and is calculated only on the initial principal: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Relationship between A, P, and R

Amount is the sum of Principal and Interest: A = P × (1 + (R × T) ÷ 100). Rate can be derived as R = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × T).

Units of Time

Always ensure time (T) is in years. If given in months, divide by 12; if given in days, divide by 365.

questions.question: An athlete runs an 800 m race in 96 seconds. His speed (in km / h) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Speed = 800 ÷ 96 m/s

To directly convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Speed = (800 ÷ 96) × (18 ÷ 5) = (25 ÷ 3) × (18 ÷ 5) = 30 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 30 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance (D) = 800 m

Time (T) = 96 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Speed (S) = Distance ÷ Time

Conversion: 1 m/s = 18/5 km/h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f389425cb9dcb9eb5fea9358348d53e08ec06a21024fe09fa968a88ded61b868.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed in m/s = 800 ÷ 96

questions.question: On selling 38 balls at Rs. 2,240, there is a loss equal to the cost price of 6 balls. The cost price of a ball is equal to:

questions.question: The exterior angle obtained on producing the base of a triangle both the ways are 121° and 104°. What is the measure of the largest angle of the triangle?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interior base angles are found by subtracting exterior angles from 180°.

First interior angle = 180° − 121° = 59°.

Second interior angle = 180° − 104° = 76°.

Third interior angle = 180° − (59° + 76°) = 180° − 135° = 45°.

Comparing 59°, 76°, and 45°, the largest value is 76°.

**∴ The correct answer is 76°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Exterior angle at one end of the base = 121°

Exterior angle at the other end of the base = 104°

**Formula Used:**

Sum of angles on a straight line = 180°

Sum of all interior angles of a triangle = 180°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d473613092c0449f4c8756d3406b35d521f8ad6c072055132a6e6539084cadc1.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the triangle be ABC with base BC. Let BC be produced to D and E.

⇒ Interior ∠ABC = 180° − Exterior ∠ABD

⇒ Interior ∠ABC = 180° − 121° = 59°

⇒ Interior ∠ACB = 180° − Exterior ∠ACE

⇒ Interior ∠ACB = 180° − 104° = 76°

⇒ We know, ∠BAC + ∠ABC + ∠ACB = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC + 59° + 76° = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC + 135° = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC = 180° − 135° = 45°

⇒ The interior angles are 59°, 76°, and 45°.

⇒ Largest angle = 76°.

**∴ The correct answer is 76°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

The sum of the exterior angles of any polygon (one at each vertex) is always 360°.

Exterior Angle Theorem

An exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of the two opposite interior angles (e.g., Ext ∠ABD = ∠BAC + ∠ACB).

Types of Triangles by Angles

Acute triangle (all angles 90°).</p

In the figure, chords AB and CD of a circle intersect externally at P. If AB = 4 cm, CD = 11 cm and PD = 15 cm, then the length of PB is:

questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For secants intersecting externally at point P, the property is: PA × PB = PC × PD.

Given: AB = 4 cm, CD = 11 cm, PD = 15 cm.

PC = PD − CD = 15 − 11 = 4 cm.

Product PC × PD = 4 × 15 = 60.

We need factors of 60 (PA and PB) such that their difference |PB − PA| = chord AB = 4 cm.

Factors of 60 with a difference of 4 are 10 and 6 (since 10 × 6 = 60 and 10 − 6 = 4).

**∴ The correct answer is 10 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of chord AB = 4 cm

Length of chord CD = 11 cm

Length of external segment PD = 15 cm

**Formula Used:**

The Secant-Secant Power Theorem states that if two secant segments are drawn to a circle from an exterior point, then the product of the measures of one secant segment and its external secant segment is equal to the product of the measures of the other secant segment and its external secant segment.

PA × PB = PC × PD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e9f08d31651098d267b57cf0dc55c1c940c6677a8afe875e6f13859de00e9b1.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ PC = PD − CD

⇒ PC = 15 − 11 = 4 cm

⇒ Let the length of segment PB be x cm.

⇒ Then, PA = PB − AB = x − 4 cm

⇒ Applying the theorem: PA × PB = PC × PD

⇒ (x − 4) × x = 4 × 15

⇒ x² − 4x = 60

⇒ x² − 4x − 60 = 0

⇒ x² − 10x + 6x − 60 = 0

⇒ x(x − 10) + 6(x − 10) = 0

⇒ (x − 10)(x + 6) = 0

⇒ x = 10 or x = −6 (Length cannot be negative)

⇒ x = 10 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 10 cm.**

Intersecting Chords Theorem (Internal)

When two chords intersect inside a circle, the product of the segments of one chord is equal to the product of the segments of the other: PA × PB = PC × PD.

Tangent-Secant Theorem

If a tangent and a secant are drawn to a circle from an exterior point, the square of the tangent segment equals the product of the whole secant and its external part: PT² = PA × PB.

Secant Segment Relation

The length of the entire secant segment is the sum of the external segment and the chord length: Whole Secant = External Segment + Chord.</p

questions.question: The sum of three numbers is 280. If the ratio between the first and second numbers is 2 : 3 and the ratio between second and third numbers is 4 : 5, find the second number.

__Shortcut Trick__

Combine ratios: A:B = 2:3 and B:C = 4:5.

To equalize B, multiply first ratio by 4 and second by 3.

Combined Ratio A : B : C = (2×4) : (3×4) : (3×5) = 8 : 12 : 15.

Sum of ratio parts = 8 + 12 + 15 = 35 units.

35 units = 280 → 1 unit = 8. ∴ 2nd number = 12 × 8 = 96.

**∴ The correct answer is 96.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of three numbers (A + B + C) = 280

Ratio A : B = 2 : 3

Ratio B : C = 4 : 5

**Formula Used:**

Combined Ratio A : B : C = (a × c) : (b × c) : (b × d) where A:B = a:b and B:C = c:d.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e345c5fae5b4662224c59163cf0599299500a53e08af73ddab75cba35ef92628.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ First : Second = 2 : 3

⇒ Second : Third = 4 : 5

⇒ Multiplying the ratios to make the Second number common:

⇒ A : B = (2 × 4) : (3 × 4) = 8 : 12

⇒ B : C = (4 × 3) : (5 × 3) = 12 : 15

⇒ Combined Ratio A : B : C = 8 : 12 : 15

⇒ Let the numbers be 8x, 12x, and 15x.

⇒ Sum = 8x + 12x + 15x = 35x

⇒ 35x = 280

⇒ x = 280 ÷ 35 = 8

⇒ Second number (B) = 12x = 12 × 8 = 96

**∴ The correct answer is 96.**

**__Additional Information__**

Ratio Balancing

To combine two ratios A:B and B:C, find the LCM of the common term B to make its value equal in both ratios.

Direct Combination Formula

If A:B = a:b and B:C = c:d, then the continuous ratio A:B:C is calculated as (a×c) : (b×c) : (b×d).

Proportional Parts

Value of any part = (Ratio of that part ÷ Sum of all ratios) × Total Value.</p

questions.question: If frac {8 + 2sqrt 3}{3sqrt 3 + 5} = asqrt 3 - b, then the value of a + b is equal to:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Rationalize the denominator by multiplying the numerator and denominator by the conjugate (5 − 3√3).

Numerator: (8 + 2√3) × (5 − 3√3) = 40 − 24√3 + 10√3 − 18 = 22 − 14√3.

Denominator: (5 + 3√3) × (5 − 3√3) = 5² − (3√3)² = 25 − 27 = −2.

Simplified Result: (22 − 14√3) ÷ (−2) = −11 + 7√3 = 7√3 − 11.

Comparing with a√3 − b, we get a = 7 and b = 11.

Calculation: a + b = 7 + 11 = 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (8 + 2√3) ÷ (3√3 + 5) = a√3 − b

**Formula Used:** Rationalization using (x + y)(x − y) = x² − y²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/806cbf2c8e0d17dbbbb9fb80c1ff9d26faa45d1cc531ba3757c305d2090d9bac.png] 

⇒ Expression = (8 + 2√3) / (5 + 3√3)

⇒ Multiply by conjugate (5 − 3√3): [(8 + 2√3) × (5 − 3√3)] / [(5 + 3√3) × (5 − 3√3)]

⇒ Numerator = 8(5) − 8(3√3) + 2√3(5) − 2√3(3√3)

⇒ Numerator = 40 − 24√3 + 10√3 − 6(3) = 40 − 14√3 − 18 = 22 − 14√3

⇒ Denominator = 5² − (3√3)² = 25 − 27 = −2

⇒ Value = (22 − 14√3) / (−2) = −11 + 7√3

⇒ Compare 7√3 − 11 with a√3 − b

⇒ a = 7, b = 11

⇒ a + b = 7 + 11 = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

**__Additional Information__**

Rationalization of Surds

To rationalize a denominator of the form (x + √y), multiply both numerator and denominator by its conjugate (x − √y) to eliminate the radical.

Conjugate Rule

The conjugate of (a + √b) is (a − √b). Their product always results in a rational number: (a + √b)(a − √b) = a² − b.

Equality of Irregular Numbers

If x + y√n = a + b√n (where x, y, a, b are rational and √n is irrational), then x = a and y = b.</p

⇒ (sec θ + tan θ) ÷ (sec θ − tan θ) = (2 × 79 + 51) ÷ 79

⇒ (sec θ + tan θ) ÷ (sec θ − tan θ) = 209/79

⇒ Applying Componendo and Dividendo:

⇒ [(sec θ + tan θ) + (sec θ − tan θ)] ÷ [(sec θ + tan θ) − (sec θ − tan θ)] = (209 + 79) ÷ (209 − 79)

⇒ (2 sec θ) ÷ (2 tan θ) = 288 ÷ 130

⇒ sec θ ÷ tan θ = 144 ÷ 65

⇒ (1/cos θ) ÷ (sin θ/cos θ) = 144/65

⇒ 1/sin θ = 144/65

⇒ sin θ = 65/144

**∴ The correct answer is 65/144.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Componendo and Dividendo Rule

It is a method used to simplify equations involving ratios. If a/b = c/d, then (a+b)/(a−b) = (c+d)/(c−d).

Pythagorean Identity

A fundamental identity in trigonometry is sec²θ − tan²θ = 1, which implies (sec θ + tan θ)(sec θ − tan θ) = 1.

Reciprocal Ratios

sec θ = 1/cos θ, cosec θ = 1/sin θ, and cot θ = 1/tan θ.</p

questions.question: The graphs of the linear equations 4x - 2y = 10 and 4x + ky = 2 intersect at a point (a, 4). The value of k is equal to:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Since the point (a, 4) lies on both lines, substitute y = 4 in the first equation.

4x − 2(4) = 10 ⇒ 4x − 8 = 10 ⇒ 4x = 18.

In the second equation 4x + ky = 2, substitute 4x = 18 and y = 4 directly.

18 + k × 4 = 2 ⇒ 4k = 2 − 18 ⇒ 4k = −16.

k = −16 ÷ 4 = −4.

**∴ The correct answer is −4.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Equation 1: 4x − 2y = 10

Equation 2: 4x + ky = 2

Intersection point: (a, 4)

**Formula Used:**

For a point (x₁, y₁) to be the intersection of two lines, it must satisfy both equations simultaneously.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fee9379b0f96bfe68122950be9b373d24f6e4a29f5f8523c1490a5bd1341904.png] 

Step 1: Substitute the coordinates of the intersection point (a, 4) into Equation 1.

⇒ 4(a) − 2(4) = 10

⇒ 4a − 8 = 10

⇒ 4a = 18

⇒ a = 18 ÷ 4 = 4.5

Step 2: Substitute x = 4.5 and y = 4 into Equation 2.

⇒ 4(4.5) + k(4) = 2

⇒ 18 + 4k = 2

⇒ 4k = 2 − 18

⇒ 4k = −16

⇒ k = −16 ÷ 4

⇒ k = −4

**∴ The correct answer is −4.**

**__Additional Information__**

Condition for Unique Solution

For two linear equations a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂ to have a unique intersection point, a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂.

Parallel Lines (No Solution)

Lines are parallel and never intersect if a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂.

Coincident Lines (Infinite Solutions)

Lines overlap completely if a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂.</p

questions.question: Find the sum of 6 + 8 + 10 + 12 + 14 + ............. + 40.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the series as an Arithmetic Progression (AP) where the first term is 6 and the last term is 40.

Average of an AP = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2 = (6 + 40) ÷ 2 = 23.

Number of terms (n) = [(Last − First) ÷ Common Difference] + 1 = [(40 − 6) ÷ 2] + 1 = 18.

Sum of the series = Average × n = 23 × 18 = 414.

**∴ The correct answer is 414.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given series: 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, ............., 40

First term (a) = 6

Last term (l) = 40

Common difference (d) = 8 − 6 = 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/668f3205140aed764fece628be774b5d761f4bb8d0ba6ffbe94011ff69985655.png] 

Formula for the nth term of an AP: l = a + (n − 1)d

⇒ 40 = 6 + (n − 1) × 2

⇒ 40 − 6 = (n − 1) × 2

⇒ 34 = (n − 1) × 2

⇒ n − 1 = 17

⇒ n = 18

Formula for the Sum (Sₙ) of an AP: Sₙ = (n/2) × (a + l)

⇒ S₁₈ = (18 ÷ 2) × (6 + 40)

⇒ S₁₈ = 9 × 46

⇒ S₁₈ = 414

**∴ The correct answer is 414.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Progression (AP)

A sequence where the difference between consecutive terms is constant. nth term Tₙ = a + (n − 1)d.

Sum of First n Natural Numbers

The sum of the first n positive integers is calculated as [n × (n + 1)] ÷ 2.

Sum of First n Even Numbers

The sum of the first n even natural numbers starting from 2 is given by n × (n + 1).

General Sum Formula

For any AP, the sum is also Sₙ = (n/2) × [2a + (n − 1)d].</p

questions.question:
In the given figure, ABCD is a rectangle and P is a point on DC such that BC = 24 cm, DP = 10 cm, and CD = 15 cm. If AP produced intersects BC produced at Q, then find the length of AQ.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa25f3e1108521f3c4893c21b8af0534cabff2a63d09bda37772570af12388eb.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In right-angled ΔADP, AP = √(AD² + DP²) = √(24² + 10²) = 26 cm.

By similar triangles, ΔADP ∼ ΔQCP (since AD || QC and A, P, Q are collinear).

The side ratio is DP : CP = 10 : (15 − 10) = 10 : 5 = 2 : 1.

Therefore, AP : PQ = 2 : 1 ⇒ PQ = 26 ÷ 2 = 13 cm.

Total length AQ = AP + PQ = 26 + 13 = 39 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 39 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** ABCD is a rectangle, BC = 24 cm, DP = 10 cm, CD = 15 cm.

**Formula:** AP = √(AD² + DP²) and Similarity Ratio: AP/PQ = DP/PC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca61fcf3f7c0ce34ac8ff491271d616fac33c656bd391b8bc7840adeba5c80eb.png] 

⇒ In rectangle ABCD, AD = BC = 24 cm and CD = AB = 15 cm.

⇒ Point P is on CD such that DP = 10 cm, so PC = CD − DP = 15 − 10 = 5 cm.

⇒ In right-angled ΔADP, using Pythagoras Theorem:

⇒ AP² = AD² + DP² = 24² + 10² = 576 + 100 = 676

⇒ AP = √676 = 26 cm.

⇒ In ΔADP and ΔQCP, ∠ADP = ∠QCP = 90° and ∠APD = ∠QPC (vertically opposite).

⇒ ∴ ΔADP ∼ ΔQCP (by AA similarity).

⇒ AP / PQ = DP / CP ⇒ 26 / PQ = 10 / 5

⇒ 26 / PQ = 2 ⇒ PQ = 13 cm.

⇒ AQ = AP + PQ = 26 + 13 = 39 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 39 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

AA Similarity Criterion

If two angles of one triangle are equal to two angles of another triangle, then the two triangles are similar, and their corresponding sides are in the same ratio.

Pythagoras Theorem

In a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: a² + b² = c².

Properties of a Rectangle

Opposite sides are equal and parallel, and each interior angle is 90°. In this problem, AD || BC implies AD || CQ.</p

questions.question: A delivery boy started from his office at 10 a.m. to deliver an article. He rode his scooter at a speed of 32 km / h. He delivered the article and waited for 15 minutes to get the payment. After the payment was made, he reached his office at 11:25 a.m., travelling at a speed of 24 km / h. Find the total distance travelled by the boy.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total time spent = 11:25 a.m. − 10:00 a.m. = 1 hour 25 minutes = 85 minutes.

Actual travelling time = 85 minutes − 15 minutes (wait) = 70 minutes = 7/6 hours.

Average speed for the entire journey = (2 × S₁ × S₂) / (S₁ + S₂) = (2 × 32 × 24) / 56 = 192/7 km/h.

Total distance = Average speed × Total travelling time = (192/7) × (7/6) = 32 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 32 km.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Departure time = 10:00 a.m. | Arrival time = 11:25 a.m. | Wait time = 15 minutes.

Speed to delivery point (S₁) = 32 km/h | Speed back to office (S₂) = 24 km/h.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88f36e74917b340f9199a39e6373d55c9f4bd04727ee3e67443164e2cdf1e609.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total duration = 1 hour 25 minutes = 85 minutes.

⇒ Total travel time = 85 − 15 = 70 minutes = 70/60 hours = 7/6 hours.

⇒ Let the distance to the delivery point be d km.

⇒ (d / 32) + (d / 24) = 7 / 6

⇒ LCM of 32 and 24 is 96.

⇒ (3d + 4d) / 96 = 7 / 6

⇒ 7d / 96 = 7 / 6

⇒ d / 96 = 1 / 6

⇒ d = 96 / 6 = 16 km.

⇒ Total distance travelled = 2 × d = 2 × 16 = 32 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 32 km.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Equal Distances

When a person travels the same distance at two different speeds x and y, the average speed for the whole journey is given by (2xy) / (x + y).

Speed-Time Relation

For a constant distance, speed is inversely proportional to time (S ∝ 1/T). The ratio of speeds is the inverse of the ratio of times taken.

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds |S₁ − S₂|.</p

questions.question: If 3 sin x + 4 cos x = 2, then the value of 3 cos x - 4 sin x is equal to:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

If a sin x + b cos x = c, then b sin x − a cos x = √(a² + b² − c²).

Here, a = 3, b = 4, and c = 2.

Value = √(3² + 4² − 2²)

Value = √(9 + 16 − 4) = √21

**∴ The correct answer is √21.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: 3 sin x + 4 cos x = 2

To find: 3 cos x − 4 sin x

Formula: (a sin x + b cos x)² + (a cos x − b sin x)² = a² + b²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5242e760f22ec304bc197baeebd7ffc30e3d6c779038d33acf95adbd8c6f87da.png] 

⇒ Let 3 cos x − 4 sin x = y

⇒ Squaring and adding both equations:

⇒ (3 sin x + 4 cos x)² + (3 cos x − 4 sin x)² = 2² + y²

⇒ (9 sin²x + 16 cos²x + 24 sin x cos x) + (9 cos²x + 16 sin²x − 24 sin x cos x) = 4 + y²

⇒ 9(sin²x + cos²x) + 16(cos²x + sin²x) = 4 + y²

⇒ 9(1) + 16(1) = 4 + y²

⇒ 25 = 4 + y²

⇒ y² = 21

⇒ y = √21

**∴ The correct answer is √21.**

**__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Coefficient Identity

For any angle x and constants a and b, the sum of the squares of (a sin x + b cos x) and (a cos x − b sin x) is always independent of x and equal to a² + b².

Maximum and Minimum Values

The expression a sin x + b cos x has a maximum value of √(a² + b²) and a minimum value of −√(a² + b²).

Secant and Tangent Relation

If a sec x + b tan x = c, then a related identity for tangent and secant is (a tan x + b sec x)² = c² − (a² − b²).</p

questions.question: The average of five positive numbers is 56. If the first number is three-fourth of the sum of the last four numbers, then the average of the last four numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total sum of 5 numbers = 56 × 5 = 280.

Ratio of First Number : Sum of last 4 numbers = 3 : 4.

Total parts = 3 + 4 = 7 parts → 280.

1 part = 280 ÷ 7 = 40.

Sum of last 4 numbers = 4 parts = 4 × 40 = 160.

Average of last 4 numbers = 160 ÷ 4 = 40.

**∴ The correct answer is 40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 5 numbers = 56

First number = 3/4 × (Sum of last 4 numbers)

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

Average = Sum of observations ÷ Number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a89de6c3070bcc8dc83ef6cac301d327418cc60478020b0cb829cc71dca301e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total sum of 5 numbers = 56 × 5 = 280

⇒ Let the sum of the last four numbers be S.

⇒ First number = 3/4 × S = 3S/4

⇒ Sum of all 5 numbers = First number + Sum of last 4 numbers

⇒ 280 = 3S/4 + S

⇒ 280 = (3S + 4S) ÷ 4

⇒ 280 = 7S/4

⇒ S = (280 × 4) ÷ 7

⇒ S = 40 × 4 = 160

⇒ Average of last 4 numbers = S ÷ 4

⇒ Average of last 4 numbers = 160 ÷ 4 = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Average Formula

The average of n numbers is calculated as Sum of all numbers ÷ n. To find the sum, use Average × n.

Weighted Average

When two groups with averages x₁ and x₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂ are combined, the new average is (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Average of Consecutive Numbers

For any arithmetic progression, the average is exactly the middle term or (First term + Last term) ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: If the radius of a cylinder is decreased by 20% and the height is increased by 20% to form a new cylinder, then the volume will be decreased by:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of Cylinder ∝ r²h

Successive change in Radius (r × r): −20% and −20% ⇒ −20 − 20 + (−20 × −20)/100 = −36%

Net change with Height (+20%): −36 + 20 + (−36 × 20)/100

Net change = −16 − 7.2 = −23.2%

**∴ The correct answer is 23.2%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Radius (r) decreased by 20%, Height (h) increased by 20%.

Formula: Volume (V) = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4b837a1094bd942d9eb952e302634ff0354cbb74248c870e94fcedcac7b7e2e.png] 

⇒ Let original radius r₁ = 5 and original height h₁ = 5.

⇒ Original Volume V₁ = π × (5)² × 5 = 125π.

⇒ New radius r₂ = 5 − (20% of 5) = 4.

⇒ New height h₂ = 5 + (20% of 5) = 6.

⇒ New Volume V₂ = π × (4)² × 6 = 16 × 6 × π = 96π.

⇒ Decrease in volume = 125π − 96π = 29π.

⇒ Percentage decrease = (29π / 125π) × 100

⇒ Percentage decrease = (29 / 125) × 100 = 23.2%.

**∴ The correct answer is 23.2%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

For two percentage changes a% and b%, the net change is given by [a + b + (ab/100)]%. For three changes, apply this formula twice.

Cylinder Formulas

Volume = πr²h | Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh | Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(h + r).

Proportionality in Geometry

When dimensions of a 3D shape change, the volume changes according to the product of the change factors of its dimensions (e.g., V ∝ r²h for cylinders, V ∝ a³ for cubes).</p

questions.question: The length of the shadow of a vertical tower on level ground increases by 10 m when the altitude of the sun changes from 45° to 30°. The height of the tower is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula for height (h) when shadow increases by distance (d) as angle changes from θ₁ to θ₂:

h = d ÷ (cot θ₂ − cot θ₁)

Here, d = 10 m, θ₂ = 30°, and θ₁ = 45°

h = 10 ÷ (cot 30° − cot 45°) = 10 ÷ (√3 − 1)

By rationalizing: h = [10 × (√3 + 1)] ÷ [(√3 − 1)(√3 + 1)] = 10(√3 + 1) ÷ 2 = 5(√3 + 1)

**∴ The correct answer is 5(√3 + 1) m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Increase in shadow length (CD) = 10 m

Angle of elevation at initial position (C) = 45°

Angle of elevation at final position (D) = 30°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/590b05f974baeb16c07ef7da327a1c5054d48442e9d8b3a3c86b884edea94ce7.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the height of the tower AB be h.

⇒ In right-angled ▵ABC, tan 45° = AB ÷ BC

⇒ 1 = h ÷ BC → BC = h

⇒ In right-angled ▵ABD, tan 30° = AB ÷ BD

⇒ 1 ÷ √3 = h ÷ BD → BD = h√3

⇒ Given CD = BD − BC = 10 m

⇒ h√3 − h = 10

⇒ h(√3 − 1) = 10

⇒ h = 10 ÷ (√3 − 1)

⇒ h = [10 × (√3 + 1)] ÷ [(√3 − 1)(√3 + 1)]

⇒ h = 10(√3 + 1) ÷ (3 − 1) = 10(√3 + 1) ÷ 2

⇒ h = 5(√3 + 1) m

**∴ The correct answer is 5(√3 + 1) m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios for Standard Angles

tan 30° = 1/√3, tan 45° = 1, tan 60° = √3. Cot is the reciprocal: cot 30° = √3, cot 45° = 1, cot 60° = 1/√3.

Shadow and Angle Relation

As the altitude of the sun decreases, the length of the shadow of a vertical object increases.

Rationalization Rule

To rationalize a denominator of the form (a − √b), multiply both numerator and denominator by its conjugate (a + √b).</p

questions.question:
In a triangle ABC, P, and Q are points on AB and AC, respectively, such that AP = 1 cm, PB = 3 cm, AQ = 1.5 cm, and CQ = 4.5 cm. If the area of ΔAPQ is 12 cm², then find the area of BPQC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/515379cbed0e259af7ab42af74eb26b674e2f8831e7f91eb853fdde1fa99b1eb.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of sides AP : AB = 1 : (1 + 3) = 1 : 4

Ratio of sides AQ : AC = 1.5 : (1.5 + 4.5) = 1.5 : 6 = 1 : 4

Ratio of Area(ΔAPQ) : Area(ΔABC) = (Side Ratio)² = (1 : 4)² = 1 : 16

Area(ΔABC) = 12 × 16 = 192 cm²

Area(BPQC) = Area(ΔABC) − Area(ΔAPQ) = 192 − 12 = 180 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 180 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: AP = 1 cm, PB = 3 cm, AQ = 1.5 cm, CQ = 4.5 cm, Area(ΔAPQ) = 12 cm².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38551b2f6be8872b2f8d7427010aa962bccab942cdd7a1ee930efa0b25646a8a.png] 

Formula Used: Area of Similar Triangles Ratio = (Corresponding Sides Ratio)²

⇒ Total length AB = AP + PB = 1 + 3 = 4 cm

⇒ Total length AC = AQ + CQ = 1.5 + 4.5 = 6 cm

⇒ In ΔAPQ and ΔABC:

⇒ AP/AB = 1/4 and AQ/AC = 1.5/6 = 1/4

⇒ ∠A is common to both triangles.

⇒ By SAS similarity criterion, ΔAPQ ~ ΔABC.

⇒ Area(ΔAPQ) / Area(ΔABC) = (AP / AB)² = (1/4)²

⇒ 12 / Area(ΔABC) = 1/16

⇒ Area(ΔABC) = 12 × 16 = 192 cm²

⇒ Area of quadrilateral BPQC = Area(ΔABC) − Area(ΔAPQ)

⇒ Area(BPQC) = 192 − 12 = 180 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 180 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

SAS Similarity Theorem

If one angle of a triangle is equal to one angle of another triangle and the sides including these angles are proportional, then the two triangles are similar.

Area Ratio Property

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides: Area₁/Area₂ = (s₁/s₂)².

Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales Theorem)

If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle to intersect the other two sides in distinct points, the other two sides are divided in the same ratio.</p

questions.question: If the perimeter of an isosceles right triangle is 8(√2 + 1) cm, then the length of the hypotenuse of the triangle is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For an isosceles right triangle with hypotenuse h, the Perimeter is given by h × (√2 + 1).

Given Perimeter = 8 × (√2 + 1) cm.

By comparing the two expressions: h(√2 + 1) = 8(√2 + 1).

⇒ h = 8 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

questions.question: A container contains 20 L mixture in which there is 10% sulphuric acid. Find the quantity of sulphuric acid to be added in it to make the solution to contain 25% sulphuric acid.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

By Alligation: Initial mixture (10% acid) vs Pure acid (100% acid) to get 25% acid.

Ratio of Initial mixture to Added acid = (100 − 25) : (25 − 10) = 75 : 15 = 5 : 1.

Initial volume is 20 L, which represents 5 units.

5 units = 20 L ⇒ 1 unit = 4 L.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 L.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Initial Mixture = 20 L

Initial Acid percentage = 10%

Required Acid percentage = 25%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7a6f36f727aef7405bba5964a4305d6cf518abb02b2a8ef8e239b2168fbecff.png] 

⇒ Quantity of acid in initial mixture = 10% of 20 = 2 L

⇒ Quantity of water in initial mixture = 20 − 2 = 18 L

⇒ Since only acid is added, the quantity of water remains constant at 18 L.

⇒ In the final solution, acid is 25%, so water must be 100% − 25% = 75%.

⇒ 75% of New Total Mixture = 18 L

⇒ New Total Mixture = 18 ÷ (75/100) = 18 × (4/3) = 24 L

⇒ Quantity of acid added = New Total − Initial Total = 24 − 20 = 4 L

**∴ The correct answer is 4 L.**

**__Additional Information__**

Alligation Rule

It is used to find the ratio in which two ingredients at given prices or concentrations must be mixed to produce a mixture of a desired price or concentration: (Quantity of Cheaper / Quantity of Dearer) = (CP of Dearer − Mean Price) / (Mean Price − CP of Cheaper).

Constant Product / Constant Quantity Rule

When a substance is added to or removed from a mixture, the quantity of the other component (which is neither added nor removed) remains constant. Using this constant value to equate percentages is often the fastest method.

Successive Dilution

If x units are removed from a container of C units of pure liquid and replaced by water, after n operations, the quantity of pure liquid remaining = C × [1 − (x/C)]ⁿ.</p

questions.question: In a triangle ABC, AB = 6√3 cm, AC = 12 cm and BC = 6 cm. Then measure of ∠B is equal to:

Check the relationship between the squares of the sides: AB = 6√3, AC = 12, BC = 6.

Calculate squares: AB² = 108, AC² = 144, BC² = 36.

Observe that 108 + 36 = 144, which means AB² + BC² = AC².

According to the Converse of Pythagoras Theorem, the angle opposite to the longest side (AC) must be 90°.

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**

questions.question: ABCD is a rhombus with ∠ABC = 52°. The measure of ∠ACD is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

In a rhombus, adjacent angles are supplementary: ∠ABC + ∠BCD = 180°.

Given ∠ABC = 52°, then ∠BCD = 180° − 52° = 128°.

Diagonals of a rhombus bisect the vertex angles, so diagonal AC bisects ∠BCD.

∠ACD = ∠BCD ÷ 2 = 128° ÷ 2 = 64°.

**∴ The correct answer is 64°.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** ABCD is a rhombus and ∠ABC = 52°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2065d84b1d8cf90e772405caa2e3169b4093cd3b655581176fe417e8153a2ac.png] 

In a rhombus, opposite sides are parallel (AB || DC and AD || BC).

⇒ ∠ABC + ∠BCD = 180° (Sum of interior angles on the same side of a transversal)

⇒ 52° + ∠BCD = 180°

⇒ ∠BCD = 180° − 52° = 128°

⇒ In a rhombus, the diagonals bisect the interior angles of the vertices.

⇒ ∠ACD = ∠ACB = ∠BCD ÷ 2

⇒ ∠ACD = 128° ÷ 2

⇒ ∠ACD = 64°

**∴ The correct answer is 64°.**

**__Additional Information__**

Diagonals Property

The diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at right angles (90°).

Area of a Rhombus

Area = 1/2 × d₁ × d₂, where d₁ and d₂ are the lengths of the diagonals.

Relation between Side and Diagonals

4 × (side)² = d₁² + d₂².

Angle Bisector Property

Each diagonal of a rhombus bisects the internal angles of the vertices it joins.</p

questions.question: The sum of two positive numbers is 240 and their HCF is 15. Find the number of pairs of numbers satisfying the given condition.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Step 1: Divide the Sum by the HCF → 240 ÷ 15 = 16.

Step 2: Find pairs of co-prime numbers (a, b) such that a + b = 16.

Step 3: Co-prime pairs are (1, 15), (3, 13), (5, 11), and (7, 9).

Total number of such valid pairs = 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 pairs.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of two numbers = 240

HCF of the numbers = 15

**Formula Used:**

If the HCF of two numbers is H, then the numbers can be represented as H × a and H × b, where a and b are co-prime integers (&gcd;(a, b) = 1).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06229b824db14ca02ce5f6ead393db56b631e984ce33147a8035cdf42a3caeb5.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the two positive numbers be 15a and 15b.

⇒ According to the problem: 15a + 15b = 240

⇒ 15(a + b) = 240

⇒ a + b = 240 ÷ 15

⇒ a + b = 16

⇒ Since a and b must be co-prime (having no common factor other than 1), we check possible pairs:

⇒ (1, 15) → &gcd;(1, 15) = 1 (Valid)

⇒ (2, 14) → &gcd;(2, 14) = 2 (Invalid)

⇒ (3, 13) → &gcd;(3, 13) = 1 (Valid)

⇒ (4, 12) → &gcd;(4, 12) = 4 (Invalid)

⇒ (5, 11) → &gcd;(5, 11) = 1 (Valid)

⇒ (6, 10) → &gcd;(6, 10) = 2 (Invalid)

⇒ (7, 9) → &gcd;(7, 9) = 1 (Valid)

⇒ (8, 8) → &gcd;(8, 8) = 8 (Invalid)

⇒ Total valid pairs = 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 pairs.**

**__Additional Information__**

HCF and Sum Property

The HCF of two numbers always divides their sum, their difference, and their LCM. If H is the HCF, then Sum = H × (a + b).

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are co-prime if their highest common factor is 1. When finding pairs using HCF, the remaining factors must be co-prime to maintain the given HCF.

Euler's Totient Function φ(n)

For finding the number of co-prime integers less than n, we use φ(n). The number of pairs (a, b) such that a + b = n and &gcd;(a, b) = 1 is φ(n) ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: The selling price of one article after allowing a discount of 15% on its cost price, is the same as the selling price of another article after allowing a discount of 25% on its cost price. SP₁ = SP₂ ⇒ 85% of CP₁ = 75% of CP₂

Ratio CP₁ : CP₂ = 75 : 85 = 15 : 17

Total units = 15 + 17 = 32 units = ₹640 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹20

CP₁ = 15 × 20 = ₹300

SP = 85% of 300 = ₹255

**∴ The correct answer is ₹255.**

Selling Price SP₁ = SP₂

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the cost price of the first article be CP₁ and the second be CP₂.

⇒ SP₁ = CP₁ − 15% of CP₁ = 85% of CP₁

⇒ SP₂ = CP₂ − 25% of CP₂ = 75% of CP₂

⇒ Since SP₁ = SP₂:

⇒ 0.85 × CP₁ = 0.75 × CP₂

Selling Price and Discount

Generally, discount is offered on Marked Price (MP), so SP = MP × (100 − D%)/100. If specifically stated on CP, then SP = CP × (100 − D%)/100.

Ratio of Cost Prices

Successive Discounts

The single equivalent discount for two successive discounts a% and b% is given by (a + b − ab/100)%.

questions.question: **A **and **B **together can do a piece of work in 12 days. **A** alone can do it in 18 days. In how many days can **B **alone can do the work?

Use the direct formula for finding the time of the second person when combined time and one person's time are given:

Days taken by B = (X × Y) ÷ (Y − X)

Where X = combined days of A and B = 12, and Y = days of A alone = 18.

__Shortcut Trick__

In trigonometry, if sin A = cos B, then the sum of the angles is 90° (A + B = 90°).

Here, (x + y) + (x − y) = 90°.

2x = 90° ⇒ x = 45°.

cos² 45° = (1 / √2)² = 1 / 2.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 / 2.**

⇒ x + y = 90° − x + y

⇒ x + x = 90° + y − y

⇒ 2x = 90°

⇒ x = 45°

⇒ cos x = cos 45° = 1 / √2

⇒ cos² x = (1 / √2)²

⇒ cos² x = 1 / 2

**∴ The correct answer is 1 / 2.**

**__Additional Information__**

Complementary Ratios

Trigonometric ratios of complementary angles satisfy: sin θ = cos (90° − θ), tan θ = cot (90° − θ), and sec θ = cosec (90° − θ).

Standard Values

Standard values for cos θ are: cos 0° = 1, cos 30° = √3/2, cos 45° = 1/√2, cos 60° = 1/2, and cos 90° = 0.

Pythagorean Identity

For any angle θ, the identity sin² θ + cos² θ = 1 always holds true.</p

questions.question: A man walks at a speed of 8 km / h. After every kilometre, he takes a rest for 4 minutes. How much time will he take to cover a distance of 6 km?

Total time = Walking time + Rest time = 45 + 20 = 65 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 65 minutes.**

⇒ Total time taken = Walking time + Rest time

questions.question: In a triangle ABC, AB = AC and the perimeter of ΔABC is 8(2 + √2) cm. If the length of BC is √2 times the length of AB, then find the area of ΔABC.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of sides AB : AC : BC = 1 : 1 : √2 (since AB = AC and BC = √2AB).

Sum of ratios for perimeter = 1 + 1 + √2 = 2 + √2.

Comparing with given perimeter 8(2 + √2), the multiplier is 8.

Sides are AB = 8 cm and AC = 8 cm.

Since 8² + 8² = (8√2)², it is a right-angled triangle at A.

Area = (1/2) × 8 × 8 = 32 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 32 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

AB = AC

BC = √2 × AB

Perimeter of ΔABC = 8(2 + √2) cm

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter = Sum of all sides

Area of right triangle = (1/2) × base × height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6c2f16f079bcea93423fac0871216c74c33a365017a51bbd3c52f9ac480e87c.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the length of AB be x cm. Then AC = x cm and BC = √2x cm.

⇒ x + x + √2x = 8(2 + √2)

⇒ 2x + √2x = 8(2 + √2)

⇒ x(2 + √2) = 8(2 + √2)

⇒ x = 8 cm

Now, checking for right-angled triangle property:

⇒ AB² + AC² = 8² + 8² = 64 + 64 = 128

⇒ BC² = (8√2)² = 64 × 2 = 128

⇒ Since AB² + AC² = BC², the triangle is right-angled at A.

⇒ Area = (1/2) × AB × AC

⇒ Area = (1/2) × 8 × 8

⇒ Area = 32 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 32 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Right Isosceles Triangle

A triangle where two sides are equal and the angle between them is 90°. The side ratios are always 1 : 1 : √2.

Heron's Formula

For any triangle with sides a, b, and c, Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)], where s is the semi-perimeter (a+b+c)/2.

Pythagoras Theorem

In a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: a² + b² = c².</p

questions.question: ABC is an equilateral triangle with side 12 cm and AD is the median. Find the length of GD if G is the centroid of ΔABC.

questions.question: If A's income is 60% less than B's income, then B's income is what percentage more than that of A's income?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of A : B = (100 − 60) : 100 = 40 : 100 = 2 : 5.

B is more than A by = 5 − 2 = 3 units.

Percentage more = (Difference ÷ Base A) × 100 = (3 ÷ 2) × 100.

Percentage more = 1.5 × 100 = 150%.

**∴ The correct answer is 150%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A's income is 60% less than B's income.

**Formula Used:**

Percentage More = [(New Value − Original Value) ÷ Original Value] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/beb0b899b363b7a800ee309bac1383a34099294e1c248b81402a99fe4a538e73.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let B's income be ₹100.

⇒ A's income = 100 − 60% of 100 = 100 − 60 = ₹40.

⇒ Difference between B and A = 100 − 40 = ₹60.

⇒ Percentage more = (60 ÷ 40) × 100.

⇒ Percentage more = (3 ÷ 2) × 100.

⇒ Percentage more = 150%.

**∴ The correct answer is 150%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Base Change Rule

If A is x% less than B, then B is [x ÷ (100 − x)] × 100% more than A.

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

60% = 3/5. If B is 5 units, A is 5 − 3 = 2 units. The increase required from A to B is 3 units on base 2, which is 3/2 = 150%.

Inverse Proportion / Product Constancy

When the product of two variables is constant, an x% decrease in one requires a [x/(100−x)] × 100% increase in the other to maintain the product.

questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (5, -3) in the line y = 3?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Reflection of a point (x, y) in the line y = k is (x, 2k − y).

Here, (x, y) = (5, −3) and k = 3.

Reflected y-coordinate = 2 × 3 − (−3) = 6 + 3 = 9.

The x-coordinate remains unchanged as 5.

**∴ The correct answer is (5, 9).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Point P = (5, −3)

Line of reflection L: y = 3

**Formula Used:**

Reflection of point (x₁, y₁) about the horizontal line y = k is given by (x₁, 2k − y₁).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e2f91b3ae5d1e8f76f20c1172f9cd7589d53a83ccce3a0009195fd06aea4b5a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ The distance of point P(5, −3) from the line y = 3 is |3 − (−3)| = 6 units.

⇒ The reflected point P' will be at the same distance of 6 units from the line y = 3, but on the opposite side.

⇒ x-coordinate of P' = x-coordinate of P = 5.

⇒ y-coordinate of P' = 3 + (Distance) = 3 + 6 = 9.

⇒ Reflected point = (5, 9).

**∴ The correct answer is (5, 9).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Reflection in X-axis and Y-axis

Reflection of (x, y) in the x-axis (y = 0) is (x, −y). Reflection in the y-axis (x = 0) is (−x, y).

Reflection in Vertical Line x = h

Reflection of point (x, y) in the line x = h is given by (2h − x, y).

Reflection in line y = x

Reflection of point (x, y) in the line y = x results in the coordinates swapping to (y, x).</p

questions.question: The sum of weights of A and B is 80 kg. 50% of A's weight is frac 5 6 times the weights of B. Find the difference between their weights.

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

50% of A = 5/6 of B ⇒ (1/2) × A = (5/6) × B

Ratio of weights A : B = (5/6) × 2 : 1 = 10/6 : 1 = 5 : 3

Total ratio parts = 5 + 3 = 8 units → 80 kg

1 unit = 10 kg

Difference between weights = 5 − 3 = 2 units = 2 × 10 kg = 20 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 20 kg.**

Given: Sum (A + B) = 80 kg

Condition: 50% of A = 5/6 of B

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1060f09c6d2df6076b508ec4918ae23962047c26e3ddb742c68f841f28010ff1.png] 

⇒ (50/100) × A = (5/6) × B

⇒ (1/2) × A = (5/6) × B

⇒ A = (5/6) × 2 × B

⇒ A = (5/3)B

Substitute A in the sum equation:

⇒ (5/3)B + B = 80

⇒ (8/3)B = 80

⇒ B = (80 × 3) ÷ 8

⇒ B = 30 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 20 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Sum Distribution

If the total sum S is divided in the ratio a:b, then the first part is S×a/(a+b) and the second part is S×b/(a+b).

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

Common conversions include 50% = 1/2, 25% = 1/4, 20% = 1/5, and 33.33% = 1/3, which simplify calculation steps.

Difference via Ratio

The difference between two quantities in ratio a:b (where a > b) is S×(a−b)/(a+b).</p

questions.question: If x + frac {16} x = 8, then the value of x² + frac {32}{x²} is:

Identify the algebraic pattern: If x + k/x = 2√k, then x = √k.

In the given equation x + 16/x = 8, here k = 16 and 2√16 = 8.

⇒ x = √16 = 4.

Substitute x = 4 into the required expression: x² + 32/x² = 4² + 32/4² = 16 + 32/16 = 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** x + 16/x = 8

**Formula Used:** (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

⇒ Multiply the given equation by x: x(x + 16/x) = 8x

⇒ x² + 16 = 8x

⇒ x² − 8x + 16 = 0

⇒ (x − 4)² = 0

⇒ x − 4 = 0 ⇒ x = 4

Now, calculate the value of the required expression:

⇒ x² + 32/x² = (4)² + 32 / (4)²

⇒ 16 + 32/16

⇒ 16 + 2

⇒ 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Quadratic Identities

Perfect square trinomials like a² − 2ab + b² = (a − b)² help in finding single values for variables in equations like x + k/x.

Special Cases for x + 1/x

If x + 1/x = 2, then x = 1. If x + 1/x = −2, then x = −1. These are specific cases of the √k rule.

Nature of Roots

When the discriminant b² − 4ac = 0, the quadratic equation has two equal real roots, as seen in x² − 8x + 16 = 0.</p

questions.question: The curved surface area of a cylinder is five times the area of its base. Find the ratio of radius and height of the cylinder.

According to the question, Curved Surface Area = 5 × Area of Base

2πrh = 5 × πr²

Dividing both sides by πr:

2h = 5r

r/h = 2/5

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 5.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of the cylinder = 5 × Area of the base

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area of a cylinder = 2πrh

Area of the base of a cylinder = πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25b14fcaa638b4d0249680fea54ed29fd5361dc51d94c0a392085001505a50ae.png]

⇒ CSA = 5 × Base Area

⇒ 2 × h = 5 × r (Since π and one r are common on both sides)

⇒ r / h = 2 / 5

⇒ r : h = 2 : 5

**__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cylinder

The Total Surface Area (TSA) includes the CSA and the area of both circular bases: TSA = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of Cylinder

The volume of a cylinder represents the capacity and is calculated as Base Area × Height: Volume = πr²h.

Relationship between Dimensions

If CSA = Base Area, then 2πrh = πr², which simplifies to r = 2h or r : h = 2 : 1.</p

questions.question: If (sin θ + cosec θ)² + (cos θ + sec θ)² = k + tan² θ + cot² θ, then the value of k is equal to:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Use substitution method: Let θ = 45°.

At θ = 45°, sin θ = cos θ = 1/√2, and cosec θ = sec θ = √2.

LHS = (1/√2 + √2)² + (1/√2 + √2)² = (3/√2)² + (3/√2)² = 4.5 + 4.5 = 9.

RHS = k + tan² 45° + cot² 45° = k + 1 + 1 = k + 2.

Equating LHS and RHS: 9 = k + 2 ⇒ k = 7.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (sin θ + cosec θ)² + (cos θ + sec θ)² = k + tan² θ + cot² θ

**Formula Used:** (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab; sin θ × cosec θ = 1; cos θ × sec θ = 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8f03dc37dd4e865d63194dd007215c4e56f0d986f83b6aa1193a74e72fa145f.png] 

⇒ LHS = (sin² θ + cosec² θ + 2 × sin θ × cosec θ) + (cos² θ + sec² θ + 2 × cos θ × sec θ)

⇒ LHS = sin² θ + cosec² θ + 2(1) + cos² θ + sec² θ + 2(1)

⇒ LHS = (sin² θ + cos² θ) + cosec² θ + sec² θ + 4

⇒ LHS = 1 + (1 + cot² θ) + (1 + tan² θ) + 4

⇒ LHS = 7 + tan² θ + cot² θ

⇒ 7 + tan² θ + cot² θ = k + tan² θ + cot² θ

⇒ k = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

**__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Trigonometric Identities

sin² θ + cos² θ = 1; 1 + tan² θ = sec² θ; 1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ.

Reciprocal Relations

cosec θ = 1/sin θ; sec θ = 1/cos θ; cot θ = 1/tan θ.

Pythagorean Property

In a right triangle with sides p, b and hypotenuse h, p² + b² = h².</p

questions.question: In a two-digit number, its unit digit exceeds its tens digit by 2 and that the product of the given number and the sum of its digits is equal to 460. The number is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Check the conditions against the given options.

Condition 1: Unit digit − Tens digit = 2.

Condition 2: Number × (Sum of digits) = 460.

For option (3) 46: Unit digit 6 − Tens digit 4 = 2 (Satisfied).

46 × (4 + 6) = 46 × 10 = 460 (Satisfied).

**∴ The correct answer is 46.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let the tens digit be x and the units digit be y.

Difference condition: y − x = 2 ⇒ y = x + 2.

Number = 10x + y.

Product condition: (10x + y)(x + y) = 460.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc6e5832fa3602f45292445d78f62f6e8cba07e9744edd9f9390ba3002522e2a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Substitute y = x + 2 into the product equation:

⇒ (10x + x + 2)(x + x + 2) = 460

⇒ (11x + 2)(2x + 2) = 460

⇒ 2(11x + 2)(x + 1) = 460

⇒ (11x + 2)(x + 1) = 230

⇒ 11x² + 11x + 2x + 2 = 230

⇒ 11x² + 13x − 228 = 0

⇒ Using quadratic formula: x = [−13 ± √(13² − 4 × 11 × (−228))] / (2 × 11)

⇒ x = [−13 ± √(169 + 10032)] / 22

⇒ x = [−13 ± √10201] / 22 = (−13 ± 101) / 22

⇒ Taking positive value: x = 88 / 22 = 4

⇒ y = 4 + 2 = 6

⇒ Number = 10(4) + 6 = 46

**∴ The correct answer is 46.**

**__Additional Information__**

Two-Digit Number Representation

A two-digit number with tens digit 'a' and units digit 'b' is always represented as 10a + b.

Digit Reversal Rule

If the digits are reversed, the new number is 10b + a. The difference between the original and reversed number is always 9 × (a − b).

Divisibility by 11

The sum of a two-digit number and its reverse (10a + b + 10b + a) is 11(a + b), which is always divisible by 11.</p

questions.question: The ratio between the present ages of A and B is 3 : 5. If the ratio of their ages five years after becomes 13 : 20, then the present age of B is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Present ratio (A : B) = 3 : 5 (difference = 2 parts)

Ratio after 5 years = 13 : 20 (difference = 7 parts)

Make the difference same: Multiply (3 : 5) by 7 and (13 : 20) by 2

New ratios: Present (21 : 35) and Future (26 : 40)

Increase in parts = 26 − 21 = 5 units, which is equal to 5 years.

1 unit = 1 year ∴ Present age of B = 35 units = 35 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 35 years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Present age ratio A : B = 3 : 5. Ratio after 5 years = 13 : 20.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/478a2d0dfa70f7c3681a0b53093f73ca7ffcb90870825cb39015d78ea3344b02.png] 

Let the present ages of A and B be 3x and 5x respectively.

According to the question:

⇒ (3x + 5) / (5x + 5) = 13 / 20

⇒ 20 × (3x + 5) = 13 × (5x + 5)

⇒ 60x + 100 = 65x + 65

⇒ 100 − 65 = 65x − 60x

⇒ 35 = 5x

⇒ x = 35 ÷ 5 = 7

⇒ Present age of B = 5x = 5 × 7 = 35 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 35 years.**

**__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two individuals remains the same throughout their lives. If A is 2 years older than B today, A will always be 2 years older than B.

Cross-Multiplication Method in Ratios

For ratios (a:b) changing to (c:d) after an increase 'k', the shortcut formula is x = k(d − c) / (ad − bc), where x is the common multiplier for the initial ratio.

Ratio Balancing

To find the common multiplier directly, multiply the terms of one ratio by the difference of terms of the other ratio to ensure the gap between terms is consistent.</p

questions.question: In how much time will the simple interest on a certain sum of money be frac 6 5 times of the sum at 20% per annum?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Simple Interest to Principal = 6/5

Rate (R) = 20% per annum

Using the relation: Time = (SI / Principal) × (100 / R)

Time = (6/5) × (100 / 20)

Time = 6/5 × 5 = 6 years

**∴ The correct answer is 6 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rate (R) = 20% per annum

Simple Interest (SI) = 6/5 × Principal (P)

**Formula Used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edc5a56289cf6579fceaab5ba70f27c7c0e82f74488ce26c7b040502321a8a03.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (6/5)P = (P × 20 × T) / 100

⇒ 6/5 = (20 × T) / 100

⇒ 6/5 = T / 5

⇒ 6 × 5 = 5 × T

⇒ T = 6 years

**∴ The correct answer is 6 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Concept

Simple Interest is calculated only on the principal amount for the entire duration. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Amount in Simple Interest

The total amount (A) after T years is the sum of Principal and Interest: A = P + SI = P(1 + RT/100).

Effective Rate of Interest

The total percentage interest over the entire period is R × T. Here, 6/5 as a percentage is (6/5) × 100 = 120%. Thus, R × T = 120%.</p

Simplify given eq: x(3 − 2/x) = 3/x ⇒ 3x − 2 = 3/x ⇒ x − 1/x = 2/3

Shortcut: If x − 1/x = k, then x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k

Here k = 2/3, so x³ − 1/x³ = (2/3)³ + 3 × (2/3)

⇒ 8/27 + 2 = (8 + 54) / 27 = 62/27

**∴ The correct answer is 62/27.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given equation: x(3 − 2/x) = 3/x

Formula used: (a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b)

⇒ 3x − 2 = 3/x

⇒ 3x − 3/x = 2

⇒ 3(x − 1/x) = 2

⇒ x − 1/x = 2/3

Cubing both sides of the equation:

⇒ (x − 1/x)³ = (2/3)³

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ − 3 × x × (1/x) × (x − 1/x) = 8/27

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ − 3 × (2/3) = 8/27

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ − 2 = 8/27

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 8/27 + 2

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (8 + 54) / 27

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 62/27

**∴ The correct answer is 62/27.**

**__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity for Addition

If x + 1/x = k, then the value of x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k.

Square Identity

If x − 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² + 2. Similarly, if x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2.

Relation between Sum and Difference

(x + 1/x)² − (x − 1/x)² = 4. This is used to convert between addition and subtraction forms.</p

SSS Similarity Criterion

If in two triangles, sides of one triangle are proportional to the sides of the other triangle, then their corresponding angles are equal and the triangles are similar.

AA Similarity Criterion

If two angles of one triangle are respectively equal to two angles of another triangle, then the two triangles are similar.

Properties of Similar Triangles

For two similar triangles, the ratio of their areas is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides: Area(▵1)/Area(▵2) = (Side1/Side2)².</p

questions.question: A man travelled a distance of 42 km in 5 hours. He travelled partly on foot at the rate of 6 km/h and partly on bicycle at the rate of 10 km/h. The distance travelled on foot is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average speed of the whole journey = 42 ÷ 5 = 8.4 km/h.

Apply Alligation on speeds: (Foot: 6) and (Bicycle: 10) with Mean (8.4).

Ratio of Time (Foot : Bicycle) = (10 − 8.4) : (8.4 − 6) = 1.6 : 2.4 = 2 : 3.

Total time parts = 2 + 3 = 5 units. Since total time is 5 hours, 1 unit = 1 hour.

Time on foot = 2 hours. Distance on foot = Speed × Time = 6 × 2 = 12 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Distance = 42 km

Total Time = 5 hours

Speed on foot = 6 km/h

Speed on bicycle = 10 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec0f2cf644eef72b83401de860acfe5cb48210d66518a1f2fb3aa76b2e63fe61.png] 

Let the time travelled on foot be 't' hours.

Then, the time travelled on bicycle = (5 − t) hours.

⇒ Distance on foot + Distance on bicycle = Total Distance

⇒ (6 × t) + 10 × (5 − t) = 42

⇒ 6t + 50 − 10t = 42

⇒ −4t + 50 = 42

⇒ 4t = 50 − 42

⇒ 4t = 8

⇒ t = 2 hours

⇒ Distance on foot = 6 km/h × 2 hours = 12 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

It is the total distance divided by the total time taken for the entire journey. Formula: Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Alligation Method for Speed

When alligation is applied to speeds, the resulting ratio is always the ratio of the time taken for each part of the journey.

Relative Speed

Speed of one object with respect to another. Same direction: S₁ − S₂ | Opposite direction: S₁ + S₂.</p

questions.question: In a triangle ABC, D is a point on BC such that frac {AB}{AC} = frac {BD}{DC}. If ∠B = 68° and ∠C = 52°, then the measure of ∠BAD is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The property AB/AC = BD/DC implies that AD is the internal bisector of ∠BAC.

∠A = 180° − (∠B + ∠C) = 180° − (68° + 52°) = 60°.

As AD is the bisector, ∠BAD = ∠A / 2 = 60° / 2 = 30°.

**∴ The correct answer is 30°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In ΔABC, ∠B = 68° and ∠C = 52°

Point D lies on BC such that AB/AC = BD/DC

**Formula Used:**

1. Sum of interior angles of a triangle = 180°

2. Internal Angle Bisector Theorem: If a line segment AD divides the opposite side BC such that AB/AC = BD/DC, then AD is the angle bisector of ∠BAC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80481fec7a89882038f29f6b5b0a304574d8ced05f2c056dbcad87d0f020840c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ In ΔABC, ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

⇒ ∠A + 68° + 52° = 180°

⇒ ∠A + 120° = 180°

⇒ ∠A = 180° − 120° = 60°

⇒ According to the Angle Bisector Theorem, since AB/AC = BD/DC, AD bisects ∠BAC.

⇒ ∠BAD = ∠A / 2

⇒ ∠BAD = 60° / 2 = 30°

**∴ The correct answer is 30°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Internal Angle Bisector Theorem

The internal bisector of an angle of a triangle divides the opposite side in the ratio of the sides containing the angle: BD/DC = AB/AC.

External Angle Bisector Theorem

If AD is the external bisector of ∠A meeting BC produced at D, then AB/AC = BD/CD.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of the three interior angles of any triangle is always constant and equal to 180°.</p

questions.question: At what rate per cent per annum will a sum of Rs. 15,625 amount to Rs. 21,952 in three years, if the interest is compounded annually?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a period of 3 years, the ratio of Amount to Principal is (1 + R/100)³.

Ratio A : P = 21952 : 15625

Take cube root for 1-year ratio ⇒ √³21952 : √³15625 = 28 : 25

Rate % = [(28 − 25) ÷ 25] × 100 = (3 ÷ 25) × 100 = 12%

**∴ The correct answer is 12%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹15,625

Amount (A) = ₹21,952

Time (n) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd9642163204ccf1513db2a0dfd90f72cf38c507afbe5687c2625a871ede4061.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 21952 = 15625 × (1 + R/100)³

⇒ 21952 ÷ 15625 = (1 + R/100)³

⇒ (28/25)³ = (1 + R/100)³

⇒ 28/25 = 1 + R/100

⇒ R/100 = 28/25 − 1

⇒ R/100 = 3/25

⇒ R = (3 × 100) ÷ 25

⇒ R = 12%

**∴ The correct answer is 12%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Compound Interest Formula

The total amount A = P(1 + r/n)ⁿt, where P is principal, r is annual rate, n is compounding frequency, and t is time in years.

Effective Rate of Interest

For two years at R%, the effective CI rate is (R + R + R²/100)%. For three years, it is (3R + 3R²/100 + R³/100²)%.

Difference between CI and SI

Difference for 2 years: D = P(R/100)². Difference for 3 years: D = P(R/100)² × (3 + R/100).
